:::{#def-affine-function}
#### Affine function of one variable

A [function](functions.qmd#def-function) $f: \reals \to \reals$
is **affine** if there are numbers $m$ and $b$ such that

$$f(x) = m x + b \quad \text{for all } x \in \reals$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-slope}
#### Slope

In the formula $f(x) = m x + b$ for an affine function $f$ (@def-affine-function),
$m$ is called the **slope** of $f$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-intercept}
#### Intercept

In the formula $f(x) = m x + b$ for an affine function $f$ (@def-affine-function),
$b$ is called the **intercept** of $f$.

:::
